why: The fake-font check reads a font's first four bytes, and a payload that began with wOF2 would pass it. A font file whose SHA-256 is a published campaign file is confirmed whatever its first bytes say. The fixture begins with wOF2 so that only the hash can catch it; the runner adds its hash to a copy of ioc/ (ADR-0045). A real font beside it is not reported.

files.code/proj/public/fonts/fa-solid-400.woff: wOF2 then a script that is not a font
files.code/proj/public/fonts/inter.woff2: wOF2 followed by bytes that are not checked

findings.match: font file matches a known campaign file (corpus fixture: fake font)
